chunks: And it was narrated from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who buys a bondwoman, then has relations with her, and then finds her pregnant. He said: “He returns her and returns something along with her.”

key_terms.الْجَارِيَةَ: a bondwoman or female slave who is the subject of the sale
key_terms.شَيْئًا: something additional given along with her as compensation
key_terms.فَيَقَعُ عَلَيْهَا: he has sexual relations with her
key_terms.يَرُدُّهَا: he returns her to the seller

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man buys a bondwoman, has relations with her, and then discovers she is pregnant?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a man who purchases a bondwoman, has relations with her, and then discovers that she was already pregnant. The Imam عليه السلام rules that she is to be returned, and compensation is also to be given along with her, indicating legal accountability in transactional and sexual matters.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3819 - Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah narrated from Abu Abdillah (as). He said: "I asked Imam (as) about a man who buys a bondwoman, then has relations with her, and later discovers that she is pregnant."
Imam (as) replied: "He must return her and also return something along with her."
